subject: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Priya Sen <priya.sen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Mar 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro — Acme Health

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the candid discussion on your search + triage workflow and the constraints you shared around latency and PHI. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Notes from our call:
  - Primary use case: clinician-facing summarization + patient intake triage (real-time, ~2–4s tail latency target)
  - Current infra: in-house GPU infra for batch tasks, prod latency concerns for interactive flows
  - Key requirements: VPC/private deployment option, SOC 2 evidence, predictable P95 latency, and ai-policy controls for PHI

- Risks / open questions:
  - Expected steady-state concurrency and tail-latency SLOs (can you confirm 200 concurrent interactive sessions as a ballpark?)
  - Any specific compliance auditors or additional logs/audit-fields you need beyond SOC 2?

- Proposed next steps:
  1) Intro call with your VP/CTO (to align execs and unblock procurement) — target: week of Mar 18
  2) Technical deep dive/demo with Neha (our solutions engineer) to validate latency profile and KV/prefix caching approach — 60 min
  3) Share SOC 2 summary and platform overview (attached)

Can you share availability windows for an exec intro (VP + CTO) and whether the CTO would prefer a short 30-min intro or to join the 60-min technical deep dive? If easier, here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min but happy to work off your calendars.

Attaching the platform overview and a short SOC 2 summary for your security team — let me know if you want the full report or auditor contact.

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-platform-overview.pdf (summary, 6 pages)
- soc2-summary.pdf (controls & audit dates)
From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Sen <priya.sen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Reed <michael.reed@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Mar 2029 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro — Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — great summary and the deck looks useful.

Quick availability note: the CTO (Michael) is generally available Tue/Thu mornings PT next week (Mar 12–16); after that he’s traveling the week of Mar 18. If we need VP-level time, Priya can typically do short 30-min syncs on Mon/Wed afternoons.

For the technical deep dive Neha mentioned, Tue 3/13 or Thu 3/15 AM PT would work for our infra leads — I can loop in the platform architects once we lock a slot.

Cc'ing Michael and Priya so they see the ask.

— Alex

Happy to run the technical deep dive / demo. To make the session most valuable, could you confirm the primary technical audience (CTO, platform architects, infra leads, security)? Also helpful: example request/response sizes, typical prompt lengths, and expected concurrency patterns for interactive sessions.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue, Mar 19 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT (deep-dive + perf targets, we’ll bring latency tests & KV cache plan)
- Thu, Mar 21 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT

I can do the 60-min deep dive + a short 15-min pre-call with any of your infra folks if you want us to tailor the demo to your stack. Zoom invite will include a link to a short perf baseline worksheet for you to complete; useful to have an infra/ops person join.
